metadata.what: measured skill of the N-body model against JPL DE440 by body: class, the forecast-step errors, the converged errors for moons, and the forecast's hindcast error
metadata.disagreement_rule: for a moon whose step is adequate (period over the forecast step at least 300) the converged system-local +5 yr error and the full-system one must agree within a factor 10, else the class is measurements_disagree
metadata.phase_loss_rule: a moon loses orbital phase when its converged +1 yr error is at least 0.1 of its orbital radius (the data separate at 0.004 and 0.41)
